description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterPlugin, which implements the method to unregister plugins from Smarty templates. It includes the method unregisterPlugin that removes a specified plugin from the registered plugins of a Smarty object.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_UnregisterPlugin
classes.description: A class providing the implementation for the Smarty method to unregister plugins from templates.

methods.name: unregisterPlugin
methods.description: Removes a plugin of a specified type and name from the Smarty object's registered plugins.
